payload.description:
• CLASSIC VINTAGE AESTHETIC BEIGE RUG: The area rug 8x10 features a harmonious blend of beige tones that evoke a timeless vintage charm, making it an ideal addition for any room in your home—from retro bohemian and rustic farmhouse to modern minimalism. Perfect rugs for living room, bedrooms, dining room rugs for under table, entryways, playrooms, or home offices, this 8x10 rug serves as the finishing touch to your interior flooring decor
  • MACHINE WASHABLE AREA RUG: Say goodbye to complicated cleaning routines! This 8x10 area rug is machine washable (please use cold water without bleach) to easily restore its pristine appearance. For daily maintenance, we recommend setting your vacuum cleaner to the lowest setting and vacuuming in one direction to avoid damaging the fibers. This time-saving cleaning method ensures your area rug stays fresh and beautiful for years to come
  • SUPER SOFT LOW PILE BEDROOM RUG: Crafted from premium recycled fibers, this rug 8x10 measures 0.32 inches thick, offering an incredibly soft touch—like walking on clouds. A bedroom rug 8x10 with a low-pile design effectively reduces dust accumulation and absorbs sound, helping you create a peaceful and comfortable retreat at home. Enjoy every barefoot moment as it significantly elevates your living experience
  • SAFE ANTI-SLIP RUG: Upgraded high-density anti-slip granule backing ensures this large area rug stays securely in place on any floor surface. Even in high-traffic areas, preventing sliding or curling. Living room rug 8x10 effectively eliminates tripping hazards, providing comprehensive safety for children, pets, and elderly family members, allowing you to enjoy peace of mind in your home
  • PET AND CHILD-FRIENDLY RUG: The nursery rugs are crafted from skin-friendly materials with a tightly woven structure. This carpet combines exceptional durability with a soft, comfortable feel. Rugs for living room 8x10 withstand daily wear from pet claw marks and children's play. It serves as both a safe playground for kids and a cozy den for pets, allowing the whole family to enjoy warm, intimate moments together
  • PACKAGING AND CUSTOMER SERVICE: You will receive 1* 8x10 carpet (Size: 120"L x 96" W x 0.32"D), folded and bagged. 24-hour customer service is available. For carpet cleaning or maintenance guidance, please contact us promptly. We are committed to providing thoughtful and attentive service
  • TIPS: Temporary creases may appear on the living room area rug upon arrival. We recommend unfolding it and leaving it flat for several days to allow it to naturally flatten. To expedite the process, gently roll it in the opposite direction, place a weight on the creased areas, or iron it (using a white towel between the rug and the iron)
  • PLEASE NOTE: The pile color of the 8 x 10 rug may appear slightly darker or lighter depending on the viewing angle, and color variations may occur across different monitors. We recommend carefully reviewing the product details before purchasing to ensure the selected rug complements your home decor
